title: Visitor arrival notification never emitted
expected: Guard scan of a valid pass alerts the issuing resident with visitor+gate context
actual: NotifVisitorArrived was a dead constant — ScanVisitorPass and CheckInVisitor updated state but emitted nothing
root_cause: Emission step omitted in Blocks 28/43 wiring

title: Member notification preferences stored but never consulted
expected: Muted categories suppressed; push_enabled=false skips push; safety/legal notices still deliver
actual: notify() wrote feed row + enqueued push unconditionally; estate_member_settings toggles were decorative
root_cause: Pref check never wired into the notify path

title: No dedupe on notification delivery
expected: At-least-once queue replay delivers at most one copy
actual: Identical event replay produced duplicate feed rows and duplicate pushes
root_cause: No dedupe key or replay guard on estate_notifications

title: Overdue-invoice flip emits no arrears reminder
expected: Lease/dues flip to overdue notifies the payer (and permitted landlord)
actual: MarkOverdueInvoices flipped status silently; NotifPaymentOverdue was a dead constant
root_cause: Maintenance job had no notification step

title: Repair status change never notifies requester
expected: Requester receives progress/change update for own request
actual: AddRepairUpdate updated status with no notification; NotifRepairUpdate dead constant
root_cause: Emission step omitted

title: No RSVP-nonresponder meeting reminder
expected: Only targeted nonresponders receive a reminder
actual: Meeting notifications existed only for create/cancel/reschedule blasts to all members
root_cause: No nonresponder query or reminder entry point

title: No nonvoter election reminder
expected: Reminder reaches entitled nonvoters without revealing ballot choices
actual: NotifElectionReminder/NotifElectionResult were dead constants; no nonvoter targeting existed
root_cause: No reminder entry point

title: In-app inbox has no archive or retention policy
expected: Read/archive/search older notifications; policy-bound history
actual: read_at + read-all exist; no archived column, no retention sweep, no search
root_cause: Schema lacks archive/retention fields; lane cannot add migrations

title: No malware/virus scan stage on uploads
expected: Pending scan inaccessible; retry transitions on scan result
actual: Direct-to-R2 presigned PUT with allowlisted ext/mime — no scan state machine
root_cause: Scanning stage never built

title: No search-index infrastructure for estate entities
expected: "Published content searchable within indexing SLA"
actual: No index — all reads are direct Postgres queries (consistent but no full-text/dedicated search)
root_cause: Search capability never built

title: List endpoints capped without cursor/offset traversal
expected: Stable no-duplicate/no-missing multi-page traversal
actual: LIMIT 50-500 hard caps; only GetAuditLog accepts offset; no cursor anywhere
root_cause: Pagination contract not implemented on list endpoints

title: Repair/task creation lacks business-key idempotency
expected: Exactly one ticket/order per business key under at-least-once retry
actual: CreateRepair/CreateTask insert unconditionally; maintenance jobs themselves are idempotent
root_cause: No dedupe key on create endpoints

title: Non-money-path audit writes are fire-and-forget
expected: Audit consistency follows fail-safe policy during logging outage
actual: audit() (non-tx) drops the row silently on error while the business action commits
root_cause: Only money paths use transactional auditTx; others call best-effort audit()

title: MFA flag is advisory — not enforced for high-risk roles
expected: Finance/super-admin login restricted until step-up verification completes
actual: estate_member_settings.two_factor_enabled is a stored preference; nothing gates privileged actions on it
root_cause: Step-up auth not wired; enforcement is a platform auth concern

title: No data-subject access (export) endpoint
expected: Authorized user can request scoped personal-data export with audit
actual: SoftDeleteAccount (delete+scrub) exists; no export/package endpoint
root_cause: DSAR export never built

title: No retention purge or legal-hold gate on visitor/estate records
expected: Expired visitor records disposed per schedule; legal holds block deletion
actual: ExpireAccessCodes flips status only; no purge job, no legal_hold flag consulted anywhere
root_cause: Retention lifecycle beyond status-expiry not built; needs schema column (hold flag)

title: Audit metadata does not systematically capture prior/new values
expected: Privileged events capture actor, prior/new values, timestamp, estate
actual: actor/action/subject/timestamp captured; prior/new values only ad-hoc in metadata
root_cause: audit() signature has no before/after fields

title: No report export (CSV/XLSX/PDF) — formula-injection N/A but feature absent
expected: Export with formula-injection safeguards; meets volume target
actual: Reports are JSON aggregates only; no export pipeline exists
root_cause: Export feature never built

title: Push token retirement on provider rejection unverified/absent
expected: Revoked token retired; failure recorded without blocking other channels
actual: SkipRetry on missing token; no explicit token retirement on rejection observed
root_cause: Token lifecycle gap in platform service

title: Platform auth/RLS/session/provider concerns outside lane scope
expected: CSRF/session/JWT/provider-secret protections verified
actual: Platform-owned surfaces — a prior pass already found a platform-wide user_profiles RLS PII exposure; this lane records rather than re-fixes
root_cause: Shared ownership

title: SOS/emergency endpoint had no abuse rate limit
expected: Abuse limited without unacceptable denial of real emergencies
actual: POST /estate/:id/emergencies was unthrottled
root_cause: No limiter attached

title: Emergency resubmission after network drop can duplicate alert
expected: Clear sent/unsent feedback; no duplicate submission
actual: Reconnect retry inserts a second open alert; no idempotency key on RaiseEmergency
root_cause: No client-supplied dedupe key on emergency raise (schema column needed)

title: Resident-side offline draft persistence absent
expected: Offline draft retained or loss explicitly warned
actual: Guard offline sync (offline_gate_logs) exists; resident issue reports have no draft store
root_cause: Resident draft feature never built

title: No platform-level provider application queue for estate vendors
expected: Super-admin queue with docs and decision status across estates
actual: Verification is per-estate (estate_admin) only; oversight routes expose vendor lists but no application/decision queue
root_cause: Platform queue workflow not built

title: No estate lifecycle state — cannot verify or suspend an estate
expected: Estate applications reviewed; suspension gates provider actions without deleting records
actual: estates has id/name/address/admin_id only — no status column, no review queue, no suspension semantics
root_cause: Schema lacks lifecycle fields; needs migration + workflow

title: No cross-estate global configuration rollout
expected: Global payment-method/policy limits roll out with versioning without clobbering local settings
actual: estate_config is strictly per-estate; no global defaults table or override merge
root_cause: Global config plane never built

title: No maker-checker / approval-threshold controls on admin actions
expected: Initiator cannot approve own high-risk action; thresholds versioned with history
actual: All estate admin mutations (ban, config, vendor verify, restriction) are single-actor; only restaurant payouts have maker-checker elsewhere
root_cause: Dual-control workflow not implemented for estate

title: No support impersonation surface
expected: Support access requires strong authz + notice + full impersonation audit
actual: grep finds no impersonation endpoint or audit action anywhere
root_cause: Feature absent platform-wide

title: User disable does not trigger gate-shift handover
expected: Disabling a user on active shift triggers safe handover/escalation
actual: BanResident marks banned_at; guard_shifts/offline logs unaffected; no handover hook
root_cause: Shift-handover linkage not built

title: No platform-wide incident banner / SLA owner tracking
expected: Scoped incident broadcast + SLA dashboard with owners
actual: Cross-estate incident/emergency listing exists; no banner broadcast, no SLA fields, no owner assignment
root_cause: Ops-plane features absent

title: No per-estate feature-flag granularity
expected: Pilot-estate module toggles
actual: FEATURE_* are env-global; no per-estate flag table
root_cause: Per-tenant flag plane not built

title: No cross-estate audit-trail search
expected: Global audit filterable by actor/merchant/estate/object/date
actual: estate_audit_log readable only per-estate by that estate's admin (GetAuditLog)
root_cause: Oversight surface lacked an audit route

title: No suspicious-access-denied aggregation/alerting
expected: Repeated cross-estate denials raise a monitored alert
actual: Access denials return 403 with no aggregation counter or alert emission
root_cause: Detection pipeline not built

title: No legacy-data import/migration tooling for estate
expected: Customers/units/opening balances/history importable with dedupe, exception reports, dry-run counts and delta re-apply
actual: Zero import surface — no endpoints, no batch tables, no exception reporting
root_cause: Module never scoped for migration tooling

title: No formal rollback path/tooling beyond additive-only policy
expected: Preagreed rollback restores consistent state
actual: Additive-only rule prevents destructive breakage but there is no rollback runbook or compensating-migration procedure for estate
root_cause: Rollback discipline undocumented
